description: This PHP source file defines the Binomial class which contains methods for calculating various binomial distributions and related statistical functions, useful in spreadsheet calculations.

classes.name: Binomial
classes.description: This class provides static methods to compute binomial distribution, cumulative binomial distributions, inverse binomial calculation, and negative binomial distribution, used in statistical calculations within spreadsheets.

methods.name: distribution
methods.description: Calculates the probability mass function or cumulative distribution function for the binomial distribution, based on input parameters, with support for array inputs.

methods.name: range
methods.description: Calculates the probability for a range of successes in binomial distribution trials, summing probabilities between specified success counts.

methods.name: negative
methods.description: Returns the negative binomial distribution probability for failures before a specified number of successes.

methods.name: inverse
methods.description: Calculates the smallest number of successes for which the cumulative probability exceeds a specified alpha threshold.

methods.name: calculateCumulativeBinomial
methods.description: Helper method that sums probabilities of binomial outcomes up to a given number of successes.
